name: Irma
message: Only of those who have wanted to kill us in the past. Or whose parents we have killed.

name: Irma
message: It is right to be suspicious. Suspicion of every one, and every thing, is the only reason I survive.

name: Irma
message: That aside, I believe that today's meal will be to your liking. The men brought home a boar from the hunt.

name: Irma
message: I've also stewed some kohlrabi. For old times' sake. Just the sort I made for you when you were a girl.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: Truly? But you know the others don't care for them!

name: Irma
message: Hm. A pity. I guess you'll have to eat them all yourself.
